WITH input AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r(
    session_id text, stream_type text, chunk_index int,
    content text, metadata jsonb, embedding text)
),
upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO knowledge_vault (session_id, stream_type, chunk_index, content, metadata, embedding)
  SELECT session_id, stream_type, chunk_index, content, metadata, embedding::vector
  FROM input
  ON CONFLICT (session_id, stream_type, chunk_index) DO UPDATE SET
    content    = EXCLUDED.content,
    metadata   = EXCLUDED.metadata,
    embedding  = EXCLUDED.embedding,
    created_at = now()
  RETURNING stream_type
),
pruned AS (
  DELETE FROM knowledge_vault kv
  WHERE kv.session_id = $2
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM input i
                    WHERE i.stream_type = kv.stream_type AND i.chunk_index = kv.chunk_index)
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT $2 AS session_id,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upserted WHERE stream_type = 'framework')    AS framework_chunks,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upserted WHERE stream_type = 'voice_sample') AS voice_chunks,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM pruned)                                       AS pruned_stale;

INSERT INTO archived_sessions
  (session_id, title, meeting_type, confidence_score, summary, participants, session_created_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, $7::timestamptz)
ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET
  title              = EXCLUDED.title,
  meeting_type       = EXCLUDED.meeting_type,
  confidence_score   = EXCLUDED.confidence_score,
  summary            = EXCLUDED.summary,
  participants       = EXCLUDED.participants,
  session_created_at = EXCLUDED.session_created_at,
  archived_at        = now()
RETURNING session_id, meeting_type, confidence_score, archived_at;
